- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The discovery of milk is believed to have happened accidentally by early humans around 10,000 years ago when they domesticated animals like cows, goats, and sheep for their meat, skin, and milk.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is hypothesized that early humans discovered milk by observing young animals nursing from their mothers and eventually attempted to milk these animals themselves.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Historically, milk has been an important source of nutrition for many cultures, consumed raw, boiled, or fermented into products like cheese and yogurt.
